checks.name: Decoded samples seek, trim, and play at doubled rate
Reverse decoded samples preserve signed time and stop at the trim start
Buffer loop points repeat the selected sample interval
Buffered high-rate playback remains audible rather than silently clamping
Disposal cancels scheduled PCM and releases source listeners/buffer ownership
Seek during suspended rendering moves to the requested sample before resuming
Concurrent decoded acquisitions share one buffer and bounded ownership is released
Real low-pass/high-pass/compressor processors change rendered PCM as configured
Delay produces an echo at its configured sample offset
Reverb produces deterministic PCM across graph rebuilds
UI voices pass through actual bus and master gains and dispose cleanly

scope: Actual Edge OfflineAudioContext decode and PCM rendering of authored runtime modules. No physical output-device, latency or interactive editor claim.
